# ezghcloud_hosted_queue_user (Resource)

A user of a Hosted Queues cluster. Its password is generated and kept in a Secret in the cluster's project; Terraform state never holds it. Permission changes apply without restarting the cluster. Destroying it deletes the user and its Secret. The user app comes with the cluster: import it to manage it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster (hqc_) it belongs to. Changing it replaces the user.
- `name` (String) Username: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. Changing it replaces the user (a new password in a new Secret).
- `project_id` (String) Project of the cluster. Changing it replaces the user.

### Optional

- `groups` (List of String) Kafka, with preset custom: the consumer groups it may use, each a name or a prefix ending in *. Changes in place.
- `preset` (String) Kafka only: admin (every topic and group, and topic configs), readWrite (produce and consume every topic, create topics), readOnly (consume every topic) or custom (topics and groups). readWrite when left out at create; removing it later keeps the current preset. Null on RabbitMQ. Changes in place.
- `topics` (Attributes List) Kafka, with preset custom: topic grants. Changes in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topics))
- `vhosts` (Attributes List) RabbitMQ only: the vhosts it may use. readWrite on the default vhost / when left out at create; removing it later keeps the current list. Null on Kafka. Changes in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vhosts))

### Read-Only

- `failure_code` (String) Why the user's last operation failed, as a code; null when it didn't.
- `failure_message` (String) Why the user's last operation failed; null when it didn't.
- `id` (String) cluster_id/name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `secret_id` (String) The Secret (sec_) holding the user's username and password and how to connect: host, port, plaintextPort and engine; on Kafka bootstrapServers, saslMechanism and securityProtocol; on RabbitMQ vhost and an amqps:// uri.
- `status` (String) What the user is doing: creating, available, modifying, rotating, deleting or failed.

<a id="nestedatt--topics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `topics`

Required:

- `access` (String) produce, consume or produceConsume.
- `topic` (String) A topic's name, a prefix of one ending in *, or * for every topic.

Optional:

- `create` (Boolean) Whether the user may create the topics it names.


<a id="nestedatt--vhosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vhosts`

Required:

- `preset` (String) readWrite, readOnly or custom.
- `vhost` (String) The vhost's name; / is the default vhost.

Optional:

- `configure` (String) With preset custom: RabbitMQ's configure regular expression.
- `read` (String) With preset custom: RabbitMQ's read regular expression.
- `write` (String) With preset custom: RabbitMQ's write regular expression.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_hosted_queue_user.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/CLUSTER_ID/NAME'
```
